text:
Maya: Heads-up — corporate WiFi just started flapping (packets dropping to stream host). We're switching the live stream to the wired backup in Room B. 6-8m delay while we swap networks. Hold Qs here.
Owen: Copy. Presenters please move to Room B and bring HDMI + USB-C adapters.
Priya: Can we move the roadmap Q&A to right after the 5min company update? Two partners dialed in early.
Maya: Yes — agreed. We'll surface roadmap first after intros.
InfraBot: network-check: backup-wired -> link up (eth1) ; packet-loss 0.0% ; route change applied.
Zoe: FYI the recorder VM hit disk pressure earlier; I'm attaching a temp NFS mount to spool recordings. Please avoid huge local saves.
Chris: If the console demo is unstable on stream, I can run it locally and hand off an MP4. I can record with: `ffmpeg -f x11grab -r 25 -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset superfast /tmp/demo.mp4`
Alex: I'll collect Qs and timestamp them in the notes doc. Link: https://redwood/internal/allhands/2026-03-23-live-notes. Post timestamps here so editing is minimal.
Priya: Also flagging product leads: please be ready for rapid follow-ups. Leadership will answer top 5 roadmap Qs live; others will go to async thread.
Maya: Quick checklist: 1) Network -> Owen/InfraBot. 2) Slides re-upload -> Zoe. 3) Roadmap upfront -> Priya/Leadership. 4) Demo clip fallback -> Chris. 5) Timestamps -> Alex.
Owen: Re-uploaded slides v5 to /handouts/allhands/2026-03-23-v5.pdf. Noted the latency chart update.
Zoe: Recorder NFS mount ready and permissions set. Upload path s3://redwood-internal/allhands/2026-03-23/raw/recording.mkv after meeting.
InfraBot: obs-fallback deployment started -> obs-fallback-2 (pipeline 1999) ; stream bridged to zoom-fallback.rtmp.
Maya: Captioning might lag ~10-20s while switching sources. Priya, Alex — please call out any misalignments during the first 3 minutes.
Chris: Done a quick dry-run of the demo capture; I'll upload the clip to S3 and paste link here when available.
Alex: Ready to log timestamps. I'll paste them in-line during the stream: e.g., "00:09 Intro ends" style.
Priya: Leadership will field the first 12 minutes for roadmap Qs. After that the floor opens for general questions.
Maya: We're queued to go live in 4. Please be in Room B in 3 minutes and ping me if you need AV help.
All: :thumbsup:
